name: Instantly
description: Instantly lets agents read campaigns, leads, and analytics, and draft campaigns and lead lists in the signed-in workspace. Each user signs in to their own Instantly account through the browser.

prompts.text: Compare the open and reply rates of my active campaigns.
Which leads replied this week, and to which campaign?
Draft a three-step follow-up sequence for the new SaaS lead list, but do not launch it.

apps.name: Instantly
apps.description: Campaigns, leads, and analytics, over Instantly's MCP server with browser sign-in.
